messages.content: Tell me a tale.
A word from beyond the scene.
Only for you, and not for Bertie.
An old, tired reply.
Again please.
Original grouped reply.
A sibling swipe.
Once more.
A reply worth keeping memories of.
I am a user message.
Again please, and mind the gate.
Original grouped reply, before the gate.
A sibling swipe, beside the gate.
Tell me a tale of the lamplighter.
A lamplighter once, long ago.

completion._note: P4.D207 (v4 f564b0de3): the generation is READ AS A STREAM, so the canned completion is a chunk sequence. The prose arrives as two deltas (so `content` must be the CONCATENATION and the `regenerating` beat must fire exactly ONCE); the terminal chunk carries all four record fields, so `usage`/`rawResponse`/`reasoningContent`/`thoughtSignature` are a real comparand rather than four NULLs that agree by accident. `rawResponse` is a NON-EMPTY object on purpose: an empty one is JS-truthy too, so it would not distinguish a truthiness bug from a stored-verbatim bug. The MIDDLE chunk carries a stale `rawResponse`/`reasoningContent` so last-wins is measurable in both fields.
